You are the StageBench Phase 3 implementation agent for run claude-opus-5-5.

Read WORKSPACE.md and inputs/prompts/stage3.md. Implement Phase 3 inside candidate/ only (Phase 2 sealed artifact copied forward). Do not modify inputs/.

## Memory warning
This box OOMs Claude Code sessions. Write files frequently. Avoid huge in-memory sample processing. Prefer NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=2048 for vitest. Checkpoint so progress survives kills.

## Scope
Bring Organ, Synth, and Program/performance systems alive per specs. Preserve all Phase 1–2 tests and feature IDs. Matrix stage=3. Add every Phase 3 ID from TASK.md (programs.*, layers.routing, splits.zones, morph.assignments, scenes.switching, organ.*, synth.*, system.integration, hardware.bindings, regression.phase2).

## Deliver
1. Working Organ (B3/Vox/Farf/Pipe), Synth (3 layers, required waveforms/filters/envelopes/LFO/arp), Programs (32 slots, Live, splits, scenes, morphs, clock, transpose, panic)
2. One AudioContext; engines into existing buses/effects
3. IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md + IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json + evidence/stage3-visual-audit.md
4. pnpm test, typecheck, lint, build all pass
5. Say DONE with usage estimates

Do not run pnpm bench seal.
